data.name: Lone Signal
data.detailed_description:
Lone Signal is a solo extraction shooter set deep inside a derelict droid factory — a place that was never supposed to stop producing. But it did. And something kept running anyway.

Drop into the factory. Loot what you can carry from the assembly lines, storage vaults, and forgotten labs. Fight or sneak past the Myrmidons — autonomous combat droids still patrolling the halls they were built to protect. Make it back to extraction, or lose your gear for good. Every raid is a choice between greed and survival.

Between raids, return to your ship — a quiet orbit above the dead world below. Craft weapons, upgrade your loadout, and plan your next drop into the factory's deeper, more dangerous sectors.

Think Escape from Tarkov's tension, stripped of PvP and built around a hostile AI world. The Myrmidons are only what's on the surface. Something deeper in the factory is still building.

Key Features:

  • Single-player PvE extraction shooter — no PvP, no squads, no toxicity

  • Permanent gear loss on death — every raid is a real risk

  • Fight or evade the Myrmidons, the factory's autonomous combat droids

  • Persistent hideout with crafting, weapon upgrades, and loadout management

  • Multiple factory sectors with escalating danger and rewards

  • Inspired by Escape from Tarkov, reimagined as a solo PvE experience

  • New enemy types and deeper factory zones planned post-launch

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Lone Signal contains violence and mature content related to its sci-fi extraction setting.
Players engage in armed combat with the Myrmidons (autonomous combat droids) and other hostile entities encountered throughout the factory. Combat may include depictions of blood and injury effects.
The player may also encounter non-graphic depictions of human and non-human remains within the factory's abandoned sectors — environmental storytelling that hints at what happened before the machines took over.
The game does not include sexual content, sexual assault, self-harm depiction, or drug/alcohol abuse. All mature elements are tied to combat and environmental storytelling connected to the factory's mystery.
